type:
∀ (t : Rocq.Corelib.Init.Datatypes.comparison),
  NativeBridge.Incremental.ListBridge.comparisonTo t =
    Rocq.Corelib.Init.Datatypes.comparison.rec Ordering.eq Ordering.lt Ordering.gt t
name: NativeBridge.Incremental.ListBridge.comparisonTo.eq_1

type:
∀ {A : Type u} (P : NativeBridge.RList A → Prop),
  (∀ (xs : NativeBridge.RList A), P xs) ↔ ∀ (xs : List A), P (NativeBridge.listOf xs)
name: NativeBridge.Incremental.ListBridge.list_forall

type:
∀ {A : Type u} (cmp : A → A → Rocq.Corelib.Init.Datatypes.comparison) (xs ys : NativeBridge.RList A),
  NativeBridge.Incremental.ListBridge.comparisonTo (Rocq.Corelib.Lists.ListDef.list_compare A cmp xs ys) =
    List.compareLex (fun x y => NativeBridge.Incremental.ListBridge.comparisonTo (cmp x y)) (NativeBridge.listTo xs)
      (NativeBridge.listTo ys)
name: NativeBridge.Incremental.ListBridge.list_compare_agrees

type:
∀ {A : Type u} (x : A) (xs : NativeBridge.RList A),
  NativeBridge.listTo (Rocq.Corelib.Init.Datatypes.list.cons A x xs) = x :: NativeBridge.listTo xs
name: NativeBridge.Incremental.ListBridge.listTo_cons

type:
∀ {A : Type u} {B : Sort v} (F : (NativeBridge.RList A → B) → Prop),
  (∀ (f : NativeBridge.RList A → B), F f) ↔ ∀ (f : List A → B), F fun xs => f (NativeBridge.listTo xs)
name: NativeBridge.Incremental.ListBridge.list_family_forall
